newsitem.title: USA: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-off $2-$3 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: San Antonio feeder cattle steady-off $2-$3 - USDA.

text.p: Compared to Monday - Feeder steers were steady to firm, except 500-600 lbs $2.00-$3.00 per cwt lower. Feeder heifers were steady to $3.00 lower with most decline on heavier weights.

Bulk of supply Medium and Large 1-2 300-600 lb feeder steers and heifers. Supply included around 10 percent cows and bulls, 25 percent feeder cattle over 600 lbs. Receipts - 499 Last Week - 301 Last Year - 1,199

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 75.50-85.50, two pkgs 87.00; 700-800 lbs 72.00- 78.00; pkg 815 lbs 70.25. Medium and Large 1-2 - two pkgs 500-600 lbs 73.00-79.50; pkg 625 lbs 74.00; 750-950 lbs 60.25- 68.50. Large 2 - Corrienties - 525-825 lbs 54.50-58.00.
